title: Awake and Seek
titleFull: Awake and Seek, perfume bottle design | Phào Design
description: A set of perfume bottles built on a many-faceted crystal form, each version in its own material and tone.
summary: A set of perfume bottles built on a many-faceted crystal form, each version carrying its own material and tone.
heroAlt: The Awake and Seek perfume bottles arranged among rock and crystal forms
cardAlt: The Awake and Seek perfume bottle set

chapters.heading: The idea
body: The name Awake and Seek describes the moment someone wakes and starts looking for something. The form comes from an uncut crystal: the body spreads into angled faces, and the shoulder pulls back to a small flat plane carrying the mark.
That mark is a bow crossed with a butterfly, set on a diamond-shaped label at the centre of the body.

chapters.heading: Materials
body: One form, different materials, and the character of the object changes entirely. The set was rendered across several options: clear glass, smoked glass, banded glass, green glass and a fully transparent crystal version.
The cap is brushed metal, giving one flat, quiet surface sitting above a body made of cuts.
points: Five material options on a single form
The diamond label stays constant across every version
The brushed metal cap gives the eye somewhere to rest
